speaker: RIKEN and Fujitsu (joint press release)
verbatim: Looking further into the future, Fujitsu and RIKEN will continue R&D efforts toward the launch of a 1,000-qubit computer, scheduled to be launched in 2026.
headline: Fujitsu and RIKEN scheduled the launch of a 1,000-qubit superconducting quantum computer for 2026.
resolution_criteria: Resolves VERIFIED if, by 31 Dec 2026 (plus grace), Fujitsu and/or RIKEN have launched a superconducting quantum computer with at least 1,000 physical qubits, announced as operational for research or customer use. PARTIALLY_VERIFIED if the launch falls in Japan's fiscal year 2026 but after the calendar year (January to March 2027), or if a 1,000-qubit chip is shown but not launched as a working system. NOT_VERIFIED otherwise.
